name: Kazoku wa (Ore Igai) Succubus Deshita ~Futari no Ane to Haha to no Seikatsu de Seieki o Shiboritoraremasu~
original_name: 家族は（俺以外）サキュバスでした ～二人の姉と母との性活で精液を搾り取られます～
source:
"Ta-dah♪ Sakura-chan, Kaede-chan. Congratulations♪ You have now awakened as a splendid succubus."

Sakuba Takuya (the protagonist's name is changeable) is in a family of four, consisting of his mother Yuri, and his twin sisters, Sakura and Kaede. Even though he is not blood-related to them, he spends his day with them like a real family.

One day, his sisters forget about themselves, crave for him and attack him. Yuri, witnessing the scene, happily announces that she is a succubus while Sakura and Kaede are partial succubi. As is the nature of succubi, they need to ingest themselves with semen regularly.

"When your sisters are in a lewd mood, I want you to comfort them."
"Specifically, it doesn't matter if it's their mouths at the top or at the bottom, just let them have lots and lots of your semen."

Accepting Yuri's proposal, with his succubi sisters, Takuya's sex life begins.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/26255/]official website[/url]]
translation:
“大大♪小樱、小枫。恭喜你们♪你们已经作为出色的魅魔觉醒了。”

佐久场拓哉（主角名字可更改）一家四口，成员包括母亲尤里、双胞胎姐妹佐仓和枫。尽管他和他们没有血缘关系，但他却像真正的家人一样和他们一起度过每一天。

有一天，他的姐妹们忘记了自己，渴望他并攻击他。尤里目睹了这一幕，高兴地宣布她是魅魔，而小樱和枫则是部分魅魔。由于魅魔的本质，她们需要定期摄入精液。

“当你姐姐们心情不好的时候，我想让你安慰她们。”
“具体来说，不管他们的嘴在上面还是在下面，只要让他们有很多很多你的精液就可以了。”

接受尤里的求婚，和他的魅魔姐妹们，拓哉的性生活开始了。
